label: Jerry (Jerome) Nelson
narrative: Jerry Nelson was a deputy missile crew commander with the 579th Strategic Missile Squadron at Walker AFB, Roswell, New Mexico, between 1962 and 1965, and is the only member of the 27 September 2010 National Press Club panel whose service was in the Atlas era and outside the northern tier. That makes him structurally useful to the cluster rather than merely additional: the whole nuclear-incursion strand is otherwise concentrated on Minuteman fields in Montana, North Dakota and Wyoming in 1965 to 1977, and a claim from a different weapon system in a different decade at a different base is the kind of data point that either widens the pattern or fails to.
